title: Morning rush in San Antonio: every bus, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in San Antonio, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the San Antonio city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Standard and Frequent.

Busiest moment of the morning: 275 buses at 9:05 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Columbus Day (October 12).
